title: From Samana to Sirhind Panic and the Opening of the Sadhaura Episode

blocks.text: This page closes the Samana aftermath by showing Banda Singh escalating the struggle from one captured town to a direct challenge against Sirhind. He sends a written message through these captured spies to Wazir Khan, making the threat explicit rather than leaving it to rumor.

The message spreads fear through Sirhind because the city now understands that earlier crimes, especially against the Sahibzadas, are about to be answered. At the same time the narrative pivots toward Sadhaura, so panic in Sirhind becomes the doorway into another campaign of retribution and expansion.
The page is therefore a crossover between triumph, warning, and new attack. It turns a local victory into a regional shockwave.
